summary: Validated the new Material Library inline preview contract. Added /app/backend/tests/test_material_preview.py (15 tests, all passing) covering: download back-compat (attachment), ?inline=1 contract on PDF (inline + application/pdf + X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN + Content-Length), DOCX inline (octet-stream + inline disposition), preview-text happy path for DOCX (body text) and PDF (non-empty text), ACL (student not-in-cohort 403 / student in-cohort 200 on library material, outsider instructor 403 / managing admin 200 on non-library cohort material), legacy file_path-only missing-file -> 410, download bytes round-trip regression for both library and cohort-specific materials, /api/library/materials list still exposes cohort_ids + assigned_cohorts, and both auth paths (Authorization: Bearer header AND ?token=<session_token> query param used by the iframe) work.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4219 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; consider splitting routers (materials, submissions, cohorts, auth, library) into separate modules for maintainability.

Tests required loading /app/frontend/.env explicitly because REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is not exported to the pytest process. Considered adding a conftest.py loading both .env files once for the whole tests/ folder (left for main agent).

download_material and preview_material_text duplicate the same ACL block verbatim (~25 lines each). Extract a single helper `_assert_material_read_access(user, material)` to keep ACL logic in one place — reduces drift risk when permission rules change.

read_bytes_from_doc only emits 410 for FileNotFoundError on the legacy file_path branch; if gridfs_id is set but the GridFS object is deleted, the underlying open_download_stream raises NoFile and currently propagates as a 500. Consider catching gridfs.errors.NoFile and converting to 410 with the same clean message for parity.

success_rate.frontend: not tested (frontend out of scope per request)

test_credentials: Super admin slewis@theboostpad.org auto-seeded; tests inject session tokens directly into user_sessions collection.
seed_data_creation: All ephemeral: 1 cohort (TEST_MatPrev_*), 3 users (1 student-in, 1 student-out, 1 outsider instructor) + admin session, 1 library DOCX material, 1 library PDF material, 1 cohort-specific DOCX material, 1 legacy 410 material doc. All teardown verified — 0 TEST_* docs remaining in mongo post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_material_preview.py for regression on /api/materials/{id}/download?inline=1 and /api/materials/{id}/preview-text. It loads /app/frontend/.env to pick up REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — copy that pattern for future tests or have main agent add a conftest.py. The PDF preview body assertion is loose (just non-empty string) because fpdf2 PDFs sometimes do not extract cleanly with all libraries — keep it permissive.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found; the new inline preview + preview-text endpoints behave per spec.
